flagged.sentence: 另一种解释是关于取舍的标准（作者推断）：金币被扔掉、照片被留下，他在这几段里没有说明原因；
扉页则被他撕了下来，这段记述没有写它的去向。
the fly-leaf was torn out, and the passage does not say what became of it.
作者提出的替代选择（他没有写自己考虑过这些）：比如把队伍分成两支，一支维持最低限度的探路，一支守营保存体力；

S-SOUTH.title: Ernest Shackleton, South: The Story of Shackleton's Last Expedition, 1914–1917 (1920 printing; archive.org OCR)

episode.outcome: 弃船：压力在下午达到顶点，他命令全员下到冰上，看着冰把船碾碎。弃船当晚他向全队宣布，打算朝保利特岛方向徒步行进。
episode.quote: Again the pressure began, and at 5 p.m. I ordered all hands on to the ice.

episode.outcome: 在海洋营等到的“第二次尝试”确实做了：又行军七天，但冰面无法通行，只好后撤。照当时的速度要三百多天才能到陆地，最后再次扎营，这就是耐心营。
episode.quote: We had been on the march for seven days; rations were short and the men were weak.

additions.start: We could even, if progress proved too difficult
additions.end: The issue is beyond my power either to predict or to control.
additions.why: 行军开始前，他已经写下“在厚浮冰上扎营、等浮冰外漂到开阔水面”这个方案，并因士气等心理原因明确否决，选择先走。这直接改变了 analysis.0 和 analysis.3 对海洋营决定的解读。

additions.start: I rather grudged the two pounds allowance per man
additions.end: And the face of the deep is frozen.
additions.why: 这里写明了留照片、扔金币的理由，也写了他同时撕下的约伯记那一页。稿件 analysis.2 称“没有说明原因”，与此相反。

additions.start: We had been on the march for seven days; rations were short and the men were weak.
additions.end: till conditions should appear more favourable for a renewal of the attempt to escape.
additions.why: 这是海洋营决定的后续结局：第二次尝试失败，才转入耐心营。证据包只有“耐心营”这个名字，稿件 story.13 因此漏掉了这次转折。

additions.start: I have told them the distance to the Barrier and the distance to Paulet Island
additions.end: we will all reach safety in the end.
additions.why: 补出行军的明确目标是朝保利特岛方向徒步，以及他当晚向全队说明了这个计划，可以充实 hook 和 context。

additions.start: Should this be done, the Transcontinental party
additions.end: as early as possible in 1915 set out on the journey.
additions.why: “立刻出发”只是原计划在十一月登陆这一前提下的安排，原文还有登陆太晚就越冬的备选。

context_issues.problem: 稿件把留照片的标准说成“没有说明、只能猜测”，但原文明确给出了理由：需要能想起家人的纪念物。

quote.quote: A man under such conditions needs something to occupy his thoughts, some tangible memento of his home and people beyond the seas.

context_issues.problem: 截断造成误导：海洋营所等待的第二次尝试实际做了，行军七天后失败，才转入耐心营。稿件写成“后来换了营地”，读者会以为海洋营的等待直接通向耐心营。

quote.quote: We had marched seven and a half miles in a direct line and at this rate it would take us over three hundred days to reach the land away to the west.

context_issues.problem: 稿件称海洋营“这一次把等待写成了计划”。实际上行军之前，他已写下“扎营、等浮冰外漂到开阔水面”这个方案，并因心理原因否决。海洋营是回到了先前否决的方案，并非首次提出。

quote.quote: We could even, if progress proved too difficult and too injurious to the boats, which we must guard as our ultimate means of salvation, camp on the nearest heavy floe, scour the neighbouring pack for penguins and seals, and await the outward drift of the pack to open and navigable water.

context_issues.problem: 稿件强调“不是唯一的可能”，但他本人已明确权衡过走与等，并写出选择行军的士气理由。应说明这一点，避免读者以为他没有考虑过替代方案。

quote.quote: It will be much better for the men in general to feel that, even though progress is slow, they are on their way to land than it will be simply to sit down and wait

context_issues.problem: 证据摘录截在逗号处，漏掉了他同时撕下的约伯记一页及所引经文。

quote.quote: and also the wonderful page of Job containing the verse

context_issues.problem: “立刻出发”是以十一月成功登陆为前提的安排，原计划还写有登陆过晚就越冬再出发的备选。

quote.quote: Should the landing be made too late in the season, the party will go into winter quarters
